name: Greater Devious Bloodline
body:
Your bloodline becomes even more pronounced as you become more devious.

Prerequisite(s): Sorcerer bloodline class feature, 3rd-level arcane trickster, Devious Bloodline

Benefit: Your levels in arcane trickster stack with your sorcerer levels for purposes of determining the power of your bloodline powers. Only your actual sorcerer levels are used to determine which powers you possess.
